source_read: https://a.storyblok.com/f/286316/x/07c5b00b47/sns-menu-uk-kcal-2026-05-210x210-web.pdf (19 pages, downloaded afresh 2026-10-08, byte-identical to the copy used for data/source; still the 'Menu with kcal' linked from sticksnsushi.com/gb/en/allergies/ on 2026-10-08, whose robots.txt allows /gb/en/; the storyblok CDN host's own /robots.txt answers 403 AccessDenied, i.e. no robots file, and the PDF is a plain public link on the chain's page)
notes: Calories-only chain. Every one of the 127 kcal values the script read (125 published + Maki Maki and Kyoto Non-Stop already held back) matches an independent pdftotext parse of every 'N kcal' / 'N / N kcal' in the PDF as a multiset (145 printed numbers = 127 + the Exmoor Caviar repeated twice + 5 set menus printed without a basis, left out by design + 11 'Adults need around 2000 kcal' footers); name-to-number mapping read by eye on rendered pages 8 (all 14 nigiri x 1 and 2 pcs), 9 (house rolls, Full House, Temaki Setto), 10 (uramaki, kaburimaki, Maki Maki), 11 (all 22 sticks x 1 and 2 pcs, Rice and its toppings), 13 and 14 (set menus) plus a heading-by-heading text match for pages 3-7: no difference. contains_pork/contains_beef tags checked against the dish names and the set-menu contents (Perfect Day: Buta Yaki free-range pork; As Good As It Gets: Hotate Bacon + Temaki Setto wagyu; Set For Success: Beef Tataki, Gyu Katzu). Allergens are link-only (the 2 Oct allergen matrix names dishes differently), so none are published to check; that guide link is still the one on the chain's page.
